scope: Local read-only fixtures; no game compatibility or universal format support claim
changes: Decode HOK variable-bit dense animation values and quaternion omission flags.
Keep GUID-only PPtr resolution local to the owner or an unambiguous object within the exact same DB.
Read the HOK split Shader code-block layout without dropping its second blob.
Validate resource ranges and require complete reads; truncate reused output files.
Automatically preview AnimationClips using referenced Animation/Animator model hierarchies, bones and available materials; autoplay with pause/resume/seeking.
Report unsupported particle/property simulation, missing materials and selected repeated-prefab variants.
In automatic export mode only, preserve raw bytes if semantic conversion fails and report the fallback explicitly.
Detect a registered per-user installation and allow safe in-place upgrades; reject locked payloads before extraction.

sourceCoverage.note: Zero typed-parser failures does not mean all objects have complete semantic readers. Partial/raw-only statuses remain visible.

animationPreview101.note: 36 scenes were generated from real object references. They are not claimed to reproduce Unity shaders or particles.

cases: locked later payload rejected before any earlier overwrite
old copy uninstaller preserves new copy registration

limitations: Full Unity ParticleSystem playback is NOT implemented. Particle data remains listed and raw-exportable.
Animation clips without a resolvable referenced model, or without supported transform tracks, cannot produce a model animation preview.
The 101 fixture contains no Material objects; its preview warns about missing materials instead of guessing texture assignments.
922 Texture2D objects in the isolated 0 fixture reference image streams absent from the loaded DBs. Their original object bytes are exportable, but those bytes do not contain the missing pixels.
HOK Shader parsing preserves split code blobs; complete shader-language reconstruction is not guaranteed.
Not all 65 local DB directories were tested. Damaged data and unknown layouts cannot be guaranteed to convert.
Install upgrade detection covers the existing current-user installer registration, not arbitrary portable copies or system-wide installations.
Rebuild remains experimental and was not validated inside the game.
